text: Fielding Legions of skeleton infantry, archers and chariots, in combination with reanimated monsters, the Dread King's Legions overwhelm the foe with resilience and numbers. The Realm of Souls means that as more friendly units are destroyed, the Dread King's Legions gain army-wide heals and eventually powerful Skeletal Minotaurs summoned through the Realm of Souls system.
